notes: Stress pair from issue #7: official IRS Form 1040, tax-year 2024 -> 2025. Form-like multi-column layout is beyond the current milestone's single-column scope, so this pair records the ceiling rather than a quality target. The sampled changes below were reviewed against the extracted text of both PDFs and correspond to known 2025 form edits (age cutoffs rolled to January 2, 1961, restructured filing-status checkboxes, new combat-zone deceased-filer checkbox, footer revision stamp). A bounded complete scope was source-reviewed on 2026-09-07; other expectations and the rest of the PDF remain partial.

changes.note: 65th-birthday cutoff rolled forward for tax year 2025; the 2024 side reads January 2, 1960.
Same cutoff roll for the spouse column.
Filing-status checkbox block was rewritten in the 2025 layout.

changes.new_quote: Filed pursuant to section 301.9100-2 Combat zone
changes.note: New deceased-filer combat zone checkbox text on the 2025 form.
Source-page review shows retained catalog/form text, a year-digit replacement, and an added creation stamp; the previous whole-footer insertion classification was incorrect.
